Test build of the fork for the October 2026 Clash of Clans UI, for Google Play Games on Windows 10/11.

- Home Village farming: Battle, Find a Match (never the Ranked card, and the ranked fill mode is gone), Attack!, Return Home.
- Auto upgrade through the new Build panel, only when one of your regular builders is free, plus one laboratory research when the lab is free. The goblin builder and researcher (paid in gems) are never used, the magic-item Confirm is never tapped, and any gem prompt is closed at once.
- Builder Base: attacks with whatever army you have, and upgrades and researches between attacks (switch on the Run page).
- Walls are bought one at a time, elixir first.
- The camera zooms out before looking for the boat.

First run: open Clash of Clans in Google Play Games on the home village, set **Auto upgrade** to **Dry run** and **Upgrade walls** off, press **Start**, and watch the Logs page for a few raids. If the picks look right, switch to **Maxer**.

Not tested in a full session yet: the screen reading was checked on 16:10 screenshots of the current game, but 16:9 windows, the zoom wheel on Google Play Games and a real upgrade start have not run. If something goes wrong, send the log (Logs page) and the `debug` folder from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BasePilot`.

Download **BasePilot.exe** (Tesseract is bundled); **BasePilot.exe.sha256** has its checksum. The exe is not signed, so SmartScreen warns: More info, then Run anyway. Botting breaks Supercell's terms of service and can get an account banned.
